import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    hist = inputs["dim_emp_hist"]
    queries = inputs["asof_queries"]

    merged = queries.merge(hist, on="emp_id", how="inner", suffixes=("_q", "_h"))

    start_ok = merged["as_of_date"] >= merged["eff_start_date"]
    end_ok = merged["eff_end_date"].isna() | (merged["as_of_date"] < merged["eff_end_date"])

    result = merged[start_ok & end_ok]

    result = result[["query_id", "emp_id", "dept", "grade"]].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"asof_result": result}
